rationale: The schema change renames the `speed_mps` field to `ground_speed_mps`. In TypeScript, this requires updating both the encoding and decoding references in the generated protobuf bindings. The `.encode()` call uses the new field name (`groundSpeedMps`), and the decoded entity access (`entity.groundSpeedMps`) is updated accordingly. The runtime observation key (`fields.ground_speed_mps`) is also renamed to match the schema.
assumptions: The generated TypeScript bindings for `VehicleTelemetry` follow camelCase naming conventions (e.g., `groundSpeedMps`).
No other parts of the codebase rely on the old field name (`speed_mps`) outside this file.
